chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and others, from Muhammad ibn Khalaf, from Abu Nahshal who said: Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated to me, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali who said:

I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: Verily, God, Majestic and Mighty, created us from the highest 'Illiyyeen, and created the hearts of our Shia from what He created us from, and created their bodies from below that, and their hearts yearn towards us because they were created from what we were created from.
Then he recited these verses: Nay! Verily the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyyeen. And what will make you know what 'Illiyyoon is? A written record, witnessed by those brought near (to God).

And He created our enemy from Sijjeen, and created their adherents' hearts from what He created them from, and their bodies from below that. So their hearts yearn towards them because they were created from what they were created from.
Then he recited these verses: Nay! The record of the wicked is indeed in Sijjeen. And what will make you know what Sijjeen is? A written record. Woe on that day to the deniers.

key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبُونَ: al-Muqarraboon — 'those brought near (to God)'; the highest category of angels and believers
key_terms.تَهْوِي: tahwa — to yearn, incline, or be drawn towards; conveys an innate gravitational pull of the heart
key_terms.سِجِّينٌ: Sijjeen — the lowest infernal realm, associated with the records of the wicked; interpreted as the spiritual origin of the enemies of the Imams
key_terms.شِيعَة: Shia — here meaning 'followers' or 'partisans'; the devoted followers of the Ahlulbayt
key_terms.عِلِّيُّونَ: 'Illiyyeen — the highest celestial realm in Islamic cosmology, associated with the records of the righteous; interpreted in Shia tradition as the spiritual origin of the Imams

ai.seo_question: Why do the hearts of believers naturally incline towards the Imams of Ahlulbayt according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) teaches that the spiritual affinity between believers and the Imams, and between the enemies of the Imams and their followers, is cosmological and ontological in nature. The Imams were created from the highest realm ('Illiyyeen), their Shia's hearts from the same substance, while their bodies are from a lower degree. Conversely, the enemies were created from Sijjeen (the lowest realm), with their adherents' hearts sharing that origin. This cosmological dualism explains the innate love of the faithful for the Imams as a natural consequence of shared ontological origin, grounding Shia devotion in the very fabric of creation.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, and someone else, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and someone else, from Muhammad Bin Khalaf, from Abu Nahshal who said, ‘Muhammad Bin Ismail narrated to me, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying that Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty created us<sup>asws</sup> from the high Illiyeen and Created the hearts of our<sup>asws</sup> Shia from what He<sup>azwj</sup> Created us<sup>asws</sup> from, and Created their bodies from besides that, and their hearts lend to yearn towards us<sup>asws</sup>, because these have been Created from what we<sup>asws</sup> have been Created from’.

Then heasws recited these Verses [83:18] Nay! Most surely the record of the righteous shall be in the Iliyeen. [83:19] And what will make you know what the highest Iliyeen is? [83:20] It is a written book, [83:21] Those of Proximity witness it.

And He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Created our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> enemies from Sijjeen, and Created their adherents from what He<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Created them from, and their bodies from besides that. Thus, their hearts yearn towards them because these were Created from what they were Created from’.

Then heasws recited these Verses [83:7] Nay! most surely the record of the wicked is in the Sijjeen. [83:8] And what will make you know what the Sijjeen is? [83:9] It is a written book. [83:10] Woe on that day to the beliers’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya and others have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalaf from abu Nahshal who has said that Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il narrated from abu Hamza al-Thumali who has the following: “I heard abu la’ far (a.s.) saying, ‘Allah, the Majestic, the Glorious, created us from the top most of paradise.

He made the hearts of our followers from that which He had created us. He created their bodies from that which is below, thus, their hearts incline to us; they are made from what He had made us.’ He then recited this verse of the Holy Quran. ‘However, the records of the deeds of the virtuous ones will certainly be in llliyin [83:18]. Would that you had known what llliyin is! (19). It is a comprehensively written Book (of records) (20). The ones nearest to Allah will bring it to the public [83:21].’ He then said, ‘Allah has created our enemies from Sijjin (the fire) and He has created the hearts of their followers from what He had created them. He created the bodies of their followers (followers of our enemies) from other matters. Thus, their hearts (the hearts of the followers of our enemies) incline to them (to our enemies) because they are created from what they (our enemies) are created.’

Then he recited this verse of the Holy Quran: ‘Let them know that the records of the sinners’ deeds are in Sijin [83:7]. Would that you had known what Sijin is! (8). It is a comprehensively written Book (of records) (9). Woe, on that day, to those who have rejected Allah’s revelations (10) and those who have rejected the Day of Judgment [83:11].’”
